name: Evidence and Diff Discipline
description: Shared Investigation Contract: cite evidence for every finding, propose diffs only in target project's proposals/, resolve target project first

name: Detect Dependencies Heuristics
description: Coupling shapes (shared fixture, order-dependence, shared live state), 47% root-cause share, thoroughness bias

name: Detect Instability Heuristics
description: Fragile selectors, fixed waits/timeouts, unhandled overlays, log-correlated confidence, 18% root-cause share

name: Detect Data Issues Heuristics
description: Shared/non-reusable test data, lifecycle gaps, hardcoded credentials/URLs, 17% root-cause share

name: Detect Duplication Heuristics
description: Structural graph similarity, similarity scoring, factor-out proposals, 18% root-cause share

name: Detect Complexity Heuristics
description: Graph complexity properties (cyclomatic, cognitive, loop depth, linear scans in loops, unguarded recursion), thresholds, cross-detector corroboration

name: Detect Logging Heuristics
description: Diagnosability gaps: silent catches, exception-dropping logs, unlogged external calls, unlogged loop failure paths — instrumentation for future root-cause analysis

name: Detect Config Heuristics
description: Hardcoded URLs/credentials/secrets, inline env-switch logic, hardcoded timeouts, unsafe parallel-execution config

name: Detect Locators Heuristics
description: Locator-strategy gaps: duplicated selectors, absent priority tiering, missing centralized element repository, distinct from raw selector fragility

name: Detect Layering Heuristics
description: Layer separation (tests/pages/components/data/utils/config/reporting), cross-layer violations, naming-convention consistency — prevention not cure

name: Detect Tech Versions Heuristics
description: Outdated Java/JUnit/Spring/Selenium/Maven/npm versions, CVE severity, breaking-migration rules, priority formula

name: Evidence Verification Guide
description: How an owner independently re-verifies graph evidence via the raw Neo4j graph, bypassing the code-graph CLI

name: Audit All Report Format
description: Consolidated ranked HTML report template grouped by root-cause family, one HTML file per audit

name: Finding and Correlation Data Model
description: Phase 1+2 data structures: Finding (raw detector output), Correlation (metadata linking findings), confidence hierarchy

name: Evidence Fusion Heuristics
description: Phase 1+2 rules for detecting correlations: Strong (same target + graph/root-cause/execution), Medium (same component/graph-neighbor/family), Weak (semantic only)

name: Opportunity and Impact Data Model
description: Phase 3 data structures: Opportunity (grouped findings), Impact (graph traversal with weighted transitive), Risk, Effort, Priority

name: Opportunity Grouping and Impact Analysis Heuristics
description: Phase 3 algorithms: Union-Find for opportunity grouping, 2-3 hop weighted graph traversal, risk/effort/confidence/priority calculations
